about: What a cleaning company may change in the Brisk design. Protected: the scroll-run clean of a flat's floor plan (let in, kitchen, bathroom, living room, bedroom, done; the cleaner's path, the mess clearing, each room's tasks ticking off), the price calculator, the what's-included tabs, the booking, layout, type and all interaction code. The company's own words, types of clean and prices, extras, checklists, promises and start times come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

clean: the example visit the hero runs through a flat. rooms are the plan's four rooms in this order: kitchen, bathroom, living room, bedroom (rename only, e.g. Lounge), each with two to four short tasks that tick off as the cleaner works. minutes is how long the visit takes; price is what it costs, as shown.
stages: six steps, in order: let in, kitchen, bathroom, living room, bedroom, done. Each a short name, a caption and a clock time.

quote.kinds: one to four types of clean, each with a base price, a price per bedroom and per bathroom, minutes [base, per bedroom, per bathroom] and whether it can be booked regularly (repeat). quote.often: how-often options with a percentage off; the last is the one-off (off 0). quote.extras: add-ons with a price, the minutes they add and which types of clean already include them (in: numbers in the order of quote.kinds). quote.limits: the bedroom and bathroom stepper ranges. quote.solo: minutes one cleaner works before a second is sent.
included.checklist: two to four room groups, each with three to eight tasks and the types of clean that do them (in). included.promises: up to three promises, each a short line and a sentence.
book.times: start times offered. book.closed: days with no cleans (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday).
